_origin: Extracted from SingularityRD robodr crates/robodr-ocsf/src/builder.rs (rule_info_for_contract), findings contract 2.1.0. Regenerate when the producer catalog changes.

robot.motion.angular_over_envelope.desc: A commanded roll/pitch rate exceeded the maximum allowed by the locked model profile for this channel.
robot.motion.angular_over_envelope.title: Roll/pitch rate command exceeds the motion envelope

robot.motion.joint_over_envelope.desc: A commanded joint speed exceeded the maximum allowed by the locked model profile for this channel.
robot.motion.joint_over_envelope.title: Joint speed command exceeds the motion envelope

robot.motion.linear_over_envelope.desc: A commanded linear speed (forward, lateral, vertical or their resultant) exceeded the maximum allowed by the locked model profile for this channel.
robot.motion.linear_over_envelope.title: Linear speed command exceeds the motion envelope

robot.motion.unprofiled_channel.desc: A motion command was observed on a channel that has no envelope in the locked model profile.
robot.motion.unprofiled_channel.title: Motion command on an unprofiled channel

robot.ros2.unauthorized_motion_writer.desc: A participant that is not in the locked model profile announced a writer on a motion/control topic.
robot.ros2.unauthorized_motion_writer.title: Unauthorized publisher on a motion topic

robot.ros2.unknown_participant.desc: A DDS participant that is not in the locked model profile announced itself on the robot's RTPS discovery bus.
robot.ros2.unknown_participant.title: Unknown DDS participant joined the robot graph

robot.ros2.unknown_reader.desc: A participant that is not in the locked model profile announced a reader; it cannot command but may collect data.
robot.ros2.unknown_reader.title: Unknown subscriber in the robot graph

robot.ros2.unknown_writer_topic.desc: A writer was announced on a topic the locked model profile does not allow anyone to publish to.
robot.ros2.unknown_writer_topic.title: Writer on a topic outside the model profile

robot.agent.control_plane_invalid.desc: The robot's control-plane API refused authenticated requests for an action, parameter, time limit or authority it never allows; each was recorded in the black box and nothing was executed.
robot.agent.control_plane_invalid.title: Invalid control-plane action request refused

robot.agent.control_plane_unauthenticate.desc: The robot's control-plane API refused requests that did not carry a valid SOC signature (missing or bad signature, unknown key, stale timestamp or replayed nonce); nothing was judged or executed.
robot.agent.control_plane_unauthenticate.title: Control-plane request failed authentication

robot.agent.correlation_pressure.desc: The correlation engine evicted or refused pending correlation state, which happens when many fresh entities arrive within a window (possibly a flood aimed at hiding a correlation).
robot.agent.correlation_pressure.title: Correlation engine state under pressure

robot.agent.evidence_degraded.desc: The black-box recorder failed to store evidence; records from this outage are missing.
robot.agent.evidence_degraded.title: Black-box recording failing

robot.agent.evidence_quarantined.desc: Opening the black box found closed segments that failed verification; they were copied to quarantine and recording continued without reusing sequence numbers.
robot.agent.evidence_quarantined.title: Damaged black-box segment quarantined

robot.agent.evidence_truncated.desc: Opening the black box found authentic proof that records after its newest integrity mark were removed; treat the evidence store as tampered with.
robot.agent.evidence_truncated.title: Black-box records cut after the newest mark

robot.agent.input_ended.desc: An agent input reached end of stream or failed while the daemon was running; detections from that input stopped.
robot.agent.input_ended.title: Agent input ended

robot.agent.input_malformed.desc: An agent input delivered items that could not be parsed; they were skipped.
robot.agent.input_malformed.title: Malformed agent input

robot.agent.input_silent.desc: An agent input delivered no valid data within the silence window; the robot state reads unknown while the agent is blind.
robot.agent.input_silent.title: Agent input silent

robot.agent.pipeline_lag.desc: Queue latency or tick delay in the agent exceeded the configured lag bound; detections are late.
robot.agent.pipeline_lag.title: Agent pipeline lagging

robot.agent.queue_overflow.desc: The agent's input queue was full and items were dropped without inspection.
robot.agent.queue_overflow.title: Agent input queue overflowed

robot.agent.spool_full.desc: The agent could not write findings to its outbound spool (full or write errors); findings may be lost before export.
robot.agent.spool_full.title: Finding spool full or failing

robot.capture.bad_checksum.desc: Captured packets failed the IPv4 header or UDP checksum; the robot's kernel drops these too (injection attempt aimed at the sensor, or a faulty interface).
robot.capture.bad_checksum.title: IP or UDP checksum failures

robot.capture.ip_fragment_conflict.desc: IP fragments overlapped with conflicting bytes, an evasion pattern; the host may reassemble different content than the sensor inspected.
robot.capture.ip_fragment_conflict.title: Conflicting overlapping IP fragments

robot.capture.ip_fragment_duplicate_conf.desc: A duplicate IP fragment differed from the queued copy (first copy kept); what was inspected may differ from what the host accepts.
robot.capture.ip_fragment_duplicate_conf.title: Duplicate IP fragment with different content

robot.capture.ip_fragment_refused.desc: IP fragments were refused because the reassembly budget was full; those datagrams were not inspected (possibly a flood aimed at blinding the sensor).
robot.capture.ip_fragment_refused.title: IP fragments refused, reassembly budget full

robot.capture.ip_reassembly_dropped.desc: IP datagrams were dropped for bad fragment geometry or reassembly timeout; they were not inspected.
robot.capture.ip_reassembly_dropped.title: IP datagrams dropped in reassembly

robot.capture.ip_reassembly_evicted.desc: Partially reassembled IP datagrams were evicted to bound memory; they were not inspected.
robot.capture.ip_reassembly_evicted.title: IP datagrams evicted from reassembly

robot.capture.malformed_frames.desc: The capture saw malformed or truncated frames; they were not inspected.
robot.capture.malformed_frames.title: Malformed or truncated captured frames

robot.capture.not_udp.desc: IP packets that were not UDP passed the kernel capture filter; they were not inspected.
robot.capture.not_udp.title: Non-UDP packets reached the sensor

robot.capture.unsupported_middleware.desc: The capture sees Zenoh (rmw_zenoh) traffic, which RoboDR does not decode: participants, publishers and motion commands on it are not inspected; with no RTPS at all the sensor is blind to the robot's bus.
robot.capture.unsupported_middleware.title: Robot middleware not inspected (Zenoh)

robot.correlate.coordinated_intrusion.desc: Within one minute an unknown DDS participant, an unauthorized motion writer and a host process anomaly were each detected; the correlation cites every contributing detection.
robot.correlate.coordinated_intrusion.title: Correlated intrusion: unknown participant, foreign motion writer and host anomaly

robot.correlate.correlation_state_evicte.desc: The correlation engine evicted a pending group that already held evidence to stay within its bounds; the named correlation rule may have missed a detection. Observe-only.
robot.correlate.correlation_state_evicte.title: Correlation evidence evicted under pressure

robot.correlate.credential_theft.desc: An SROS 2 private key was read outside the ROS stack and an unknown or source-mismatched participant appeared afterwards within the correlation window.
robot.correlate.credential_theft.title: Correlated credential theft: SROS 2 key read, then a foreign participant

robot.correlate.defense_tampering.desc: A host rule saw a RoboDR or Pulsar protected file change or a service stop while the agent reported an input silent or ended; observe-only by construction.
robot.correlate.defense_tampering.title: Correlated defense tampering: protected file or service change with a silent input

robot.correlate.discovery_flood.desc: Unknown DDS participants were announced from many distinct source addresses within the correlation window: a discovery flood or scan.
robot.correlate.discovery_flood.title: Correlated discovery flood: unknown participants from many addresses

robot.correlate.host_process_persistence.desc: The same host process raised several host-side detections within the correlation window.
robot.correlate.host_process_persistence.title: Correlated host activity: one process tripped several host rules

robot.correlate.motion_hijack.desc: A foreign motion writer or a firewall source rejection was followed by uncommanded motion, feedback divergence or a second feedback publisher within the correlation window.
robot.correlate.motion_hijack.title: Correlated motion hijack: foreign motion source, then unexpected motion

robot.correlate.sensor_evasion.desc: Repeated capture or fragment refusals coincided with discovery traffic the sensor could not inspect, a pattern consistent with an attempt to blind the sensor.
robot.correlate.sensor_evasion.title: Correlated sensor evasion: capture refusals with uninspected discovery

robot.correlate.spoofed_motion_source.desc: A participant or endpoint source mismatch was followed by an unauthorized motion writer from the same source address within the correlation window.
robot.correlate.spoofed_motion_source.title: Correlated spoofed motion source from one address

robot.correlate.trojaned_package_key_acc.desc: A package install or maintainer script was followed by an SROS 2 private key read within the correlation window.
robot.correlate.trojaned_package_key_acc.title: Correlated supply-chain compromise: package install, then key access

robot.dds.unknown_raw_writer.desc: A writer was announced on a non-ROS DDS topic the locked model profile does not allow.
robot.dds.unknown_raw_writer.title: Writer on a raw DDS topic outside the model profile

robot.firewall.events_dropped.desc: The motion firewall's event buffer was full and events were dropped or evicted; this finding is as severe as the worst event lost.
robot.firewall.events_dropped.title: Motion firewall events dropped

robot.firewall.internal_fault.desc: The motion firewall failed its own post-condition check and applied its configured fault policy to the command.
robot.firewall.internal_fault.title: Motion firewall internal fault

robot.firewall.limited_acceleration.desc: The motion firewall limited a command's acceleration to the channel's bound (in observe mode: would have limited).
robot.firewall.limited_acceleration.title: Motion command acceleration limited

robot.firewall.limited_jerk.desc: The motion firewall limited a command's jerk to the channel's bound (in observe mode: would have limited).
robot.firewall.limited_jerk.title: Motion command jerk limited

robot.firewall.limited_speed.desc: The motion firewall limited a command's speed to the channel's bound (in observe mode: would have limited).
robot.firewall.limited_speed.title: Motion command speed limited

robot.firewall.rejected_clock_regression.desc: The motion firewall rejected a command because the gateway clock went backwards (in observe mode: would have rejected).
robot.firewall.rejected_clock_regression.title: Motion command rejected: clock regression

robot.firewall.rejected_future_timestamp.desc: The motion firewall rejected a command stamped in the future (in observe mode: would have rejected).
robot.firewall.rejected_future_timestamp.title: Motion command rejected: future timestamp

robot.firewall.rejected_kind_mismatch.desc: The motion firewall rejected a command whose kind (twist or joints, joint count) does not match the channel (in observe mode: would have rejected).
robot.firewall.rejected_kind_mismatch.title: Motion command rejected: kind mismatch

robot.firewall.rejected_non_finite.desc: The motion firewall rejected a command carrying NaN or infinity (in observe mode: would have rejected).
robot.firewall.rejected_non_finite.title: Motion command rejected: non-finite value

robot.firewall.rejected_out_of_order.desc: The motion firewall rejected a command stamped no later than the previous one from the same source on the channel, a replay or reordering (in observe mode: would have rejected).
robot.firewall.rejected_out_of_order.title: Motion command rejected: out of order

robot.firewall.rejected_over_hard_limit.desc: The motion firewall rejected a command whose speed exceeded the channel's hard-reject bound (in observe mode: would have rejected).
robot.firewall.rejected_over_hard_limit.title: Motion command rejected: over hard limit

robot.firewall.rejected_rate_limited.desc: The motion firewall rejected a command over the channel's rate limit (in observe mode: would have rejected).
robot.firewall.rejected_rate_limited.title: Motion command rejected: rate limit

robot.firewall.rejected_stale.desc: The motion firewall rejected a command older than its freshness bound (in observe mode: would have rejected).
robot.firewall.rejected_stale.title: Motion command rejected: stale

robot.firewall.rejected_unauthorized_sou.desc: The motion firewall rejected a command from a source not authorised on the channel (in observe mode: would have rejected).
robot.firewall.rejected_unauthorized_sou.title: Motion command rejected: unauthorised source

robot.firewall.rejected_unknown_channel.desc: The motion firewall rejected a command on a channel its policy does not know (in observe mode: would have rejected).
robot.firewall.rejected_unknown_channel.title: Motion command rejected: unknown channel

robot.firewall.rejected_unknown_source.desc: The motion firewall rejected a command from a source its policy does not know (in observe mode: would have rejected).
robot.firewall.rejected_unknown_source.title: Motion command rejected: unknown source

robot.host.pulsar_threat.desc: A Pulsar runtime-security rule fired on the robot controller (process, file or network activity of the host operating system); the detail names the Pulsar rule and the process.
robot.host.pulsar_threat.title: Host runtime-security detection (Pulsar rule)

robot.motion.cross_sensor_disagreement.desc: Two independent feedback sources persistently disagreed about the platform's motion.
robot.motion.cross_sensor_disagreement.title: Independent motion sensors disagree

robot.motion.decode_anomaly.desc: A decoded motion or feedback sample carried an oddity that did not stop decoding, such as trailing bytes.
robot.motion.decode_anomaly.title: Motion sample decode anomaly

robot.motion.feedback_divergence.desc: Measured feedback stayed apart from what the observed commands predict for longer than the configured tolerance.
robot.motion.feedback_divergence.title: Motion feedback diverges from commands

robot.motion.frozen_feedback.desc: Motion feedback was frozen, silent or carried anomalous timestamps; the platform's motion cannot be verified.
robot.motion.frozen_feedback.title: Motion feedback frozen or silent

robot.motion.inconsistent_feedback_strea.desc: One feedback stream repeatedly jumped between values faster than the platform can accelerate: interleaved publishers under one identity, or a faulty driver.
robot.motion.inconsistent_feedback_strea.title: Inconsistent motion feedback stream

robot.motion.invalid_feedback.desc: Motion feedback carried NaN or infinity.
robot.motion.invalid_feedback.title: Motion feedback with a non-finite value

robot.motion.multiple_feedback_publisher.desc: More than one publisher interleaved samples for the same feedback source type.
robot.motion.multiple_feedback_publisher.title: Several publishers for one feedback source

robot.motion.non_finite_command.desc: A motion command carried NaN or infinity on at least one axis; no envelope can bound it.
robot.motion.non_finite_command.title: Motion command with a non-finite value

robot.motion.sample_source_mismatch.desc: A decoded motion or feedback sample came from a source address not bound to its writer's participant.
robot.motion.sample_source_mismatch.title: Motion sample from an address not bound to its writer

robot.motion.unattributed_sample.desc: A motion or feedback sample came from a writer that was never announced, or whose binding is unbound or contested; it was not treated as authorised.
robot.motion.unattributed_sample.title: Motion sample from an unattributed writer

robot.motion.uncommanded_motion.desc: Feedback measured motion while the observed command was rest or absent.
robot.motion.uncommanded_motion.title: Uncommanded motion

robot.motion.undecodable_sample.desc: A sample on a motion or feedback topic could not be decoded; it was not inspected.
robot.motion.undecodable_sample.title: Undecodable motion or feedback sample

robot.motion.unverifiable_command.desc: A decoded command's speed cannot be bounded from the message, so no envelope can check it.
robot.motion.unverifiable_command.title: Motion command that cannot be bounded

robot.profile.invalid_envelope.desc: The profile's envelope for this channel has an invalid or missing mandatory limit; every command on the channel is reported (fail closed).
robot.profile.invalid_envelope.title: Motion envelope in the profile cannot be enforced

robot.ros2.ambiguous_discovery.desc: A discovery announcement repeats an identity parameter with conflicting values; DDS stacks differ on which one wins, so what was inspected may not be what a stack acts on.
robot.ros2.ambiguous_discovery.title: Ambiguous discovery announcement

robot.ros2.endpoint_source_mismatch.desc: An endpoint announcement for a participant came from an address not bound to it, or was relayed or GUID-conflicting from an untrusted address.
robot.ros2.endpoint_source_mismatch.title: DDS endpoint announced from an unbound address

robot.ros2.endpoint_unannounced_particip.desc: An endpoint announcement referred to a participant with no participant announcement within the hold window, or the hold queue overflowed.
robot.ros2.endpoint_unannounced_particip.title: DDS endpoint for a participant that never announced itself

robot.ros2.identity_instances_exceeded.desc: A participant matched a stable identity of the profile (source IP, DDS vendor, enclave) whose allowed instances are all held by live participants; it is not trusted.
robot.ros2.identity_instances_exceeded.title: Extra DDS participant claims a robot identity

robot.ros2.participant_removed.desc: A participant in the locked model profile was announced as disposed or unregistered.
robot.ros2.participant_removed.title: Profiled DDS participant removed

robot.ros2.participant_source_mismatch.desc: A participant announcement for a bound participant came from an address outside its binding, or was relayed by an untrusted address; it was not learned.
robot.ros2.participant_source_mismatch.title: DDS participant announced from an unbound address

robot.ros2.profile_refused.desc: The model profile failed validation and is not enforced; the sensor reports in observe-only mode.
robot.ros2.profile_refused.title: Model profile refused

robot.ros2.profile_state_tampered.desc: The profile anti-rollback state file is missing or older than the newest accepted-profile record in the black box; the black-box record was used as the baseline.
robot.ros2.profile_state_tampered.title: Profile anti-rollback state missing or behind the black box

robot.ros2.unknown_action.desc: A writer was announced on a ROS 2 action topic or service the locked model profile does not allow.
robot.ros2.unknown_action.title: Writer on an action outside the model profile

robot.ros2.unknown_reader_topic.desc: A reader was announced on a topic, service or action outside the profile's reader allowlist; it cannot command but may collect data.
robot.ros2.unknown_reader_topic.title: Subscriber on a topic outside the reader allowlist

robot.ros2.unknown_service.desc: A writer was announced on a ROS 2 service request or reply the locked model profile does not allow.
robot.ros2.unknown_service.title: Writer on a service outside the model profile

robot.rtps.discovery_fragment_conflict.desc: Discovery fragments overlapped already received bytes with different content; a DDS stack may act on a different announcement than the one inspected.
robot.rtps.discovery_fragment_conflict.title: Conflicting discovery fragments

robot.rtps.discovery_fragment_evicted.desc: Partially reassembled discovery samples were evicted to stay within the reassembler's bounds; those announcements were not inspected.
robot.rtps.discovery_fragment_evicted.title: Partial discovery samples evicted

robot.rtps.discovery_fragment_rejected.desc: Discovery fragments were refused (over a cap, bad geometry or no capacity); that announcement was not inspected.
robot.rtps.discovery_fragment_rejected.title: Discovery fragments refused

robot.rtps.discovery_not_inspected.desc: The parser had to drop all or part of a discovery datagram (unsupported version, malformed parameter list, undecodable name); that content was not inspected.
robot.rtps.discovery_not_inspected.title: Discovery traffic not inspected

robot.rtps.discovery_removal.desc: A discovery dispose or unregister arrived for an entity other than a profiled participant.
robot.rtps.discovery_removal.title: Discovery dispose or unregister

robot.rtps.fragmented_discovery.desc: Discovery data arrived fragmented (DATA_FRAG) and was reassembled before inspection.
robot.rtps.fragmented_discovery.title: Fragmented RTPS discovery data

robot.rtps.malformed_discovery.desc: The RTPS parser saw discovery content a well-behaved DDS stack would not send.
robot.rtps.malformed_discovery.title: Malformed RTPS discovery traffic

robot.safety_state.undecodable_sample.desc: A safety-state sample from a trusted writer could not be decoded; that source reads unknown until a valid sample arrives.
robot.safety_state.undecodable_sample.title: Undecodable safety-state sample

robot.safety_state.unmapped_value.desc: A trusted safety-state source carried a value the configured mapping does not cover; that source reads unknown.
robot.safety_state.unmapped_value.title: Safety-state value outside the configured mapping

robot.safety_state.untrusted_source.desc: A safety-state sample came from a writer the locked model profile does not vouch for; it was ignored and the safety state was not taken from it.
robot.safety_state.untrusted_source.title: Safety-state sample from an untrusted writer

robot.safety_state.writer_overflow.desc: A safety-state source saw more fresh writers or socket connections than it keeps; that source reads at least unknown until the extra writers go stale.
robot.safety_state.writer_overflow.title: Safety-state writer table overflowed

robot.sensor.findings_capped.desc: One input produced more findings than the per-datagram cap; the least severe were suppressed.
robot.sensor.findings_capped.title: Sensor findings capped for one input

robot.firewall.crc_invalid.desc: A low-level joint command arrived with an invalid frame checksum, or unchecked where the channel requires one; the motion firewall rejected it (in observe mode: would have).
robot.firewall.crc_invalid.title: Joint command integrity check failed

robot.firewall.disabled_motor_energised.desc: A low-level joint command energises a motor slot the profile marks as unused (non-zero torque or gain); the motion firewall rejected it (in observe mode: would have).
robot.firewall.disabled_motor_energised.title: Disabled motor energised

robot.firewall.joint_gain_below_minimum.desc: The motion firewall rejected a low-level joint command whose stiffness or damping gain is below the joint's minimum (a disabled motor counts as zero gains); gains are never raised (in observe mode: would have rejected).
robot.firewall.joint_gain_below_minimum.title: Joint command gain below minimum

robot.firewall.joint_gain_out_of_envelop.desc: The motion firewall found a low-level joint command whose stiffness or damping gain lies outside the joint's range; gains are only ever lowered, a gain below its minimum is rejected (in observe mode: would have).
robot.firewall.joint_gain_out_of_envelop.title: Joint command gain out of envelope

robot.firewall.joint_hold_exceeded.desc: The motion firewall has been holding a humanoid's last valid joint frame for longer than the configured hold time because newer frames keep being rejected; it keeps holding with the feed-forward torque removed and needs escalation.
robot.firewall.joint_hold_exceeded.title: Humanoid joint hold exceeded its time limit

robot.firewall.joint_limp_frame.desc: A low-level joint command for a humanoid leaves every enabled joint without stiffness or damping, which makes the robot fall; the motion firewall rejected it and held the last valid frame (in observe mode: would have).
robot.firewall.joint_limp_frame.title: Humanoid joint command would go limp

robot.firewall.joint_mode_inconsistent.desc: A low-level joint command switches a motor off while carrying non-zero gains or torque for it; the motion firewall rejected it rather than forward unchecked values (in observe mode: would have).
robot.firewall.joint_mode_inconsistent.title: Joint command mode inconsistent

robot.firewall.joint_mode_pin_mismatch.desc: A low-level joint command carries a frame-level mode (ankle control mode or robot variant) other than the one the channel is pinned to, which changes what the joint envelope means; the motion firewall rejected it (in observe mode: would have).
robot.firewall.joint_mode_pin_mismatch.title: Joint command operating mode changed

robot.firewall.joint_pd_torque_out_of_en.desc: The motion firewall found a low-level joint command whose stiffness times position step exceeds the joint's proportional torque bound and stepped or rejected it (in observe mode: would have).
robot.firewall.joint_pd_torque_out_of_en.title: Joint command proportional torque out of envelope

robot.firewall.joint_position_out_of_env.desc: The motion firewall found a low-level joint command whose position target lies outside the joint's envelope and clamped or rejected it (in observe mode: would have).
robot.firewall.joint_position_out_of_env.title: Joint command position out of envelope

robot.firewall.joint_rate_violation.desc: The gap between two low-level joint commands on a channel exceeded its configured maximum interval; recorded only, the late frame is still decided normally.
robot.firewall.joint_rate_violation.title: Joint command stream gap

robot.firewall.joint_step_out_of_envelop.desc: The motion firewall found a low-level joint command whose position target moved further from the previous accepted target than the joint's per-frame step bound and stepped or rejected it (in observe mode: would have).
robot.firewall.joint_step_out_of_envelop.title: Joint command position step out of envelope

robot.firewall.joint_torque_out_of_envel.desc: The motion firewall found a low-level joint command whose feed-forward torque exceeds the joint's bound and clamped or rejected it (in observe mode: would have).
robot.firewall.joint_torque_out_of_envel.title: Joint command torque out of envelope

robot.firewall.joint_velocity_out_of_env.desc: The motion firewall found a low-level joint command whose velocity target exceeds the joint's bound and clamped or rejected it (in observe mode: would have).
robot.firewall.joint_velocity_out_of_env.title: Joint command velocity out of envelope

robot.motion.api_id_out_of_range.desc: A robot API request carried a call id outside the 32-bit range the robot dispatches on, so the robot executes a different call than the one written.
robot.motion.api_id_out_of_range.title: Robot API request with an aliased call id

robot.motion.command_type_mismatch.desc: A writer on a profiled motion command channel announced a type name other than the one the locked profile records for the channel, a type no decoder knows, or a feedback type: its commands cannot be checked as the profile intends.
robot.motion.command_type_mismatch.title: Motion command writer with an unexpected type

robot.motion.control_handover.desc: A command hands motor control to, or takes it from, another channel or controller (motion switcher release, user or arm SDK control).
robot.motion.control_handover.title: Motor control handed to another channel

robot.ros2.discovery_flood.desc: One source address (or many) announced more new DDS participants than are reported one by one; their per-participant findings are folded into this one, with the count per rule, first and last seen and sample GUID prefixes, and each is still recorded in the black box. A GUID spray or a discovery scan, possibly aimed at flooding the findings path.
robot.ros2.discovery_flood.title: Discovery flood: unknown participants aggregated

robot.unitree.legacy_port_rtps.desc: A datagram on a configured Unitree legacy UDP port also parses as RTPS; it was inspected on both paths. DDS traffic on the legacy command ports is not normal and can be an attempt to evade the legacy sender check.
robot.unitree.legacy_port_rtps.title: RTPS traffic on a Unitree legacy UDP port

robot.unitree.legacy_sender_flood.desc: Unitree legacy (unitree_legged_sdk) UDP frames arrived from more unlisted source addresses than are reported one by one, or listed command senders appeared with many different wrong link-layer addresses; the frames are counted in aggregate. A spoofed-source flood or a scan of the robot's command ports.
robot.unitree.legacy_sender_flood.title: Unitree legacy UDP frames from many unknown hosts

robot.unitree.legacy_sender_mac_mismatch.desc: A Unitree legacy UDP command came from a configured command sender IP, but its link-layer source address is not the MAC bound to that IP (or could not be verified because the datagram was reassembled from fragments): another host on the LAN may be using the sender's address.
robot.unitree.legacy_sender_mac_mismatch.title: Unitree legacy command from a listed IP with the wrong MAC

robot.unitree.legacy_unknown_sender.desc: A Unitree legacy (unitree_legged_sdk, Go1 generation) UDP command or state frame came from a source address the sensor configuration does not list; the protocol is unauthenticated, so an unlisted command sender can drive the robot.
robot.unitree.legacy_unknown_sender.title: Unitree legacy UDP frame from an unknown host

correlate_generic.desc: A deployment-specific correlation rule combined several detections that were each reported on their own; the correlation cites every contributing detection.
correlate_generic.title: Correlated RoboDR detection

generic.desc: The detection core reported a deviation from the locked model profile for a rule without a catalog entry.
generic.title: RoboDR model-profile deviation
